levels.source_supported: Specific claim directly supported by an identified source.
levels.cross_source: Same material fact independently supported by multiple source classes.
levels.institutional: Supported by an institutional/national-library or academic catalogue.
levels.verified_scope: Qualified only for the exact fields corroborated; never promotes unrelated entity fields.

rule: Qualification attaches to claims/fields, not automatically to an entire artist, release, scene, or historical narrative.
